about: Free Music for Kemy Sounds. Each file is 64–96 kbps mono and trimmed to about 60–90 seconds. CC0, public domain, CC BY, and CC BY-SA allow these edits when the track page says so. To add another track later, drop an mp3 in assets/sounds/ and add an object to tracks with id, title, artist, mood (happy, chill, hype, funny, adventure, spooky), license, source (the page that states the license), file, and via. No code change is required. Do not add NC, ND, Pixabay, or YouTube-only tracks.
